original_text: Limitation of Liability. Each party's total aggregate liability arising out of or related to this Agreement shall not exceed one million dollars ($1,000,000).
suggested_text: Limitation of Liability. Each party's total aggregate liability arising out of or related to this Agreement shall not exceed five million dollars ($5,000,000), provided that this limitation shall not apply to Excluded Claims.
rationale: MSAs with an annual contract value above $250,000 require an aggregate liability cap of at least $5,000,000, and the cap must not be narrowed by an undisclosed carve-out. Rewritten to the standard language of LIAB-CAP-FLOOR v3. Grounded in Section 2.2, Section 1.2, Section 1.1, Section 4.1, Section 7.3.

original_text: Payment. Customer shall pay all undisputed invoices within thirty (30) days of receipt. Customer hereby waives and releases and discharges any right to withhold payment of undisputed amounts.

rationale: Any waiver of withholding rights must preserve a carve-out for amounts disputed in good faith. Rewritten to the standard language of PAY-WITHHOLD-DISPUTE v2.
